fields.statement: Plan review round 3 left finding f2 (missing-acceptance on ship-local-gate): The acceptance's last clause, 'in this repo rhiza daemon settings --json lists rhiza.ship.localGate with value make check from the project settings', cannot be produced or checked from the leaf's commit: project settings live in the repo's git config (internal/api/daemon_settings.go), which is untracked and shared by every worktree of the live repo, so a builder would have to mutate the live checkout's config and a verifier's result depends on machine state, not the code. Make it a check on the setting's definition/default (or a testscript with its own repo), and leave configuring this repo to a separate step. The critic confirmed it: Verified: project settings are read from the project's git config (internal/api/daemon_settings.go:22-23, ScopeProject), and .git/config is untracked and shared by every worktree of the live repo. The clause 'in this repo rhiza daemon settings --json lists rhiza.ship.localGate with value make check' therefore checks machine state, not the leaf's commit. A builder cannot satisfy it with a commit, and a verifier's result depends on whether someone ran git config on that machine. The acceptance should check the setting's definition (key, scope, empty default) or use a testscript with its own repo, and leave configuring Rhiza's own gate to a separate step. How should it be settled?
